statements.text: The self-model theory states what properties a representation in an information-processing system must have to become phenomenal, a representation whose content is also a content of consciousness. It offers a catalogue of ten constraints, of which the précis treats six: globality, presentationality, transparency, convolved holism, dynamicity and perspectivalness, each analyzed on phenomenological, representational, functional and neural levels.

sources.quote: It offers a catalogue of 10 constraints for conscious representations.
what properties representations in a given information-processing system must possess in order to become phenomenal representations
